gaps: Reduce Home Loans is a direct-to-consumer lender and mortgage manager that also operates its own in-house brokerage ("access to over 40 lenders"); no third-party broker accreditation channel is published. Status recorded as research_only.

Reduce's published TMD index mixes its own products (Capitalizer, Ezy Reduce, Eco) with third-party lender TMDs it distributes (Heritage/People's Choice, Macquarie, BOQ, Bank of Sydney). The 'Discount Variable' link on the Reduce TMD page resolves to a Heritage Bank TMD, so nothing from those third-party documents has been recorded against Reduce.
No servicing parameters published at all.
No income-type table or shading percentages; alt-doc income evidence requirements are not published.

No credit-history policy published, although the Ezy Reduce TMD notes that terms and LVR 'will vary depending on ... credit history. E.g., discharged bankrupt or defaults', implying near-prime appetite that is not quantified publicly.
No minimum unit size, high-density, postcode or rural policy published.
Reduce's own ABN and ACL were not established from the pages read; only the funder BC Securities Pty Ltd (ACL 482240) is named.
The primary Capitalizer TMDs are dated 31 March 2024 and may read as stale.

Source documents (reduceloans.com.au TMD PDFs) sit behind a bot filter returning HTTP 403 to automated clients, so they cannot be re-verified on a schedule. All four URLs were confirmed present on the live Target Market Determinations index by hand on 2026-07-29, but the PDF CONTENTS were not re-read at that time — re-open them before relying on the LVR and loan-size figures.
